rationale: The primary input_encoding supplies local marking conditions: candidate not smaller than any later value, and no earlier equal maximum. Retain >= versus literal not-< readings of not-smaller, treating the earlier equal-maximum check as equality to the candidate. Do not silently add an earlier-greater exclusion from the high-level desired global-maximum description: it is absent from these stated conditions. Nonfinite semantics are unresolved, not an explicit admission guard. The narrower line13 nomination is separate from correctness of these conditions.

interpretations.meaning: Later comparisons use >=; reject an equal-valued earlier candidate.
interpretations.expression: all(values[i] >= values[k] for k in indices if k > i) and not any(values[j] == values[i] for j in indices if j < i)

interpretations.meaning: Later comparisons use literal not-<; retain the same earlier equality exclusion.
interpretations.expression: not any(values[i] < values[k] for k in indices if k > i) and not any(values[j] == values[i] for j in indices if j < i)
